Traits Signal

Your Crescendo requires 4 Encore rather than 5, and after it resolves your Encore pool is 1 rather than 0. You may Crescendo at exactly 4 Encore, spending 3 of them. Everything else about Crescendo is unchanged: 1 action, every ally in range gains one Standing Reroll, and it lasts 1 minute. The retained point is ordinary Encore — an ally may spend it immediately, and it is lost when your Broadcast ends like any other.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (Encore/Crescendo cost math) and SB2 (Crescendo's payload is a Standing Reroll grant). No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either. No Reroll rule-element key exists anywhere in Foundry's pf2e system (confirmed: zero hits for "key": "Reroll" in pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/, and the full 34-entry rule-element key list has no reroll key -- RollTwice is a different, pre-result advantage/disadvantage mechanic). Encore's core primitive, "spend 1 Encore to reroll a failed check," is a post-result reroll and is categorically unbuildable as a standing rule element.
